spans.s: ह्नु vt. 2Ā (pp. ह्नुत; pres. ह्नुते) 1. To take away, to abstract, to rob, यमस्याह्नोष्ट विक्रमम् Bt.xv.88; 2. to withhold, to conceal; 3. to hide from anyone, to deny before anyone, (with a dat., e.g. कृष्णाय ह्नुते ‘he hides from Kṛṣṇa’).With अप-, to conceal, to conceal from, अपह्नुवानस्य जनाय यन्निकामधीरतामस्य कृतं मनोभुवा Na.i.49.With नि-, 1. to conceal, to hide, Bt.x.36; 2. to conceal from, to hide from, to deny before anyone, (with a dat.), Bt.viii.74.
